title: oplismenus hirtellus subsp. undulatifolius
intro: Oplismenus hirtellus subsp. undulatifolius, commonly known as wavy hair grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Oplismenus hirtellus subsp. undulatifolius include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
